name: Suzuki TL1000S
engine: 996 cc liquid-cooled 90-degree V-twin, fuel injected, rotary rear damper
intro: Suzuki's big V-twin sport bike. 1997 bikes had a steering recall. The rotary rear damper is the part to look at.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 1997 TL1000S bikes are in recall 97V093 for a steering and handlebar part.
A-002.reason: The fix is free if it was never done.

add.title: Check the rear rotary damper
add.instructions: With the bike on a stand, look for oil at the rotary damper beside the shock spring and feel for damping when you push down on the rear. A leaking or dead damper needs rebuilding or replacing.
add.reason: The TL1000S uses a separate rotary damper instead of a normal shock, and old ones leak.

forums.name: TLZone
